_claim: Origin's activeBg — the mouse-DOWN instant on a menu row, distinct from the hover state C-6 covers. Resolved by reusing SidebarMenuButton's own established active:bg-accent convention rather than inventing a pressed colour.
_finding_accent_pressed_is_undefined: The recipe reads active:bg-[var(--accent-pressed,var(--accent))]. Measured on the live document, --accent-pressed does NOT resolve — it is undefined, so what actually ships is the var() fallback to --accent. That is why this row's pressed value is identical to C-6's hover value. The custom property anticipates a distinct pressed token that no one has authored; until one exists, pressed and hover are the same colour, which is a real design question this row should surface rather than hide behind a var() that looks like it resolves. Same for --accent-selected on the data-[active=true] rule.
_shares_an_anchor_with_C-6: Anchors name elements, not divergences. C-6 and C-8 describe the same row in two different states, so one anchor and two specs is correct.
